comment: The filter is the Ripples band-pass, ported from Mutable Instruments, and the modulation voltage is added to the filter's exponential frequency control and then floored at the knob setting (src/Pinpple.cpp:517, v_oct = min(v_oct, 0)), so modulation only ever lowers the frequency. The frequency jack is named '1V/Oct Frequency CV' by the maker and the arithmetic bears that out to within a third of a per cent. Each trigger also adds a random offset to the frequency and decay of about six parts in a hundred thousand of full scale (src/Pinpple.cpp:375-383); that is too small to be worth a line. The panel prints FREQ, DECAY, FM AMT, LPG IN MIX, TRIG IN and OUTPUT; the mute button, the volume trimmer and the three attenuverters carry no lettering. Lettering is drawn in code at src/Pinpple.cpp:772-815.
